title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #20 (Term 2)

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #20 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is a mukhaffafah najasa? (1 mark)
   A. A pure thing
   B. A medium najasa
   C. A light najasa
   D. A heavy najasa

2. How should we treat dogs? (1 mark)
   A. Cruelly
   B. Ignore hunger
   C. Kindly, but avoid their saliva
   D. Hit them

3. How is a medium najasa cleaned? (1 mark)
   A. Wash seven times with soil
   B. Ignore it
   C. Sprinkle once
   D. Remove it and wash with water until colour, smell and taste go

4. What is a good habit for cleaning after using the toilet? (1 mark)
   A. Use water and wash hands with soap
   B. Leave it
   C. Use nothing
   D. Skip washing

5. Which spots are often missed in wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. The teeth
   B. The top of the head only
   C. The nose only
   D. Heels, elbows and behind the ears

6. What is wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Giving zakat
   B. Washing certain body parts with water before prayer
   C. Reciting the Qur'an
   D. A journey

7. What do we recite after wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. A song
   B. The testimony of faith
   C. Surah Al-Masad
   D. Nothing

8. In which direction does the sun rise? (1 mark)
   A. West
   B. North
   C. South
   D. East

9. Which prayer is prayed at dawn? (1 mark)
   A. Fajr
   B. Asr
   C. Dhuhr
   D. Isha

10. In which city is the Kaaba? (1 mark)
   A. Madinah
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Makkah

11. Which is a pillar and not a condition? (1 mark)
   A. Time of prayer
   B. Ruku
   C. Facing the Qibla
   D. Wudhu

12. What is ruku? (1 mark)
   A. Standing
   B. Sitting
   C. Prostrating
   D. Bowing

13. Which animal is often used to pull ploughs on farms? (1 mark)
   A. Zebra
   B. Ox
   C. Lion
   D. Giraffe

14. Which of these is one of Allah's creatures? (1 mark)
   A. A goat
   B. A chair
   C. A phone
   D. A stone wall

15. A girl wants to play football modestly. Which outfit suits? (1 mark)
   A. Tracksuit with long trousers and sports headscarf
   B. A see-through top
   C. A torn shirt
   D. A very tight top

16. What does the Qur'an (7:26) say is the best clothing? (1 mark)
   A. The newest
   B. The clothing of righteousness
   C. The brightest
   D. The most expensive

17. How can too much screen time affect a child? (1 mark)
   A. Helps prayer
   B. Wastes time and harms eyes and sleep
   C. Improves health
   D. Makes them taller

18. Which of these should you never share with strangers? (1 mark)
   A. Your favourite food
   B. The weather
   C. Your favourite colour
   D. Your passwords

19. Which group deserves help? (1 mark)
   A. A person who wants an easy life
   B. A person who wants toys
   C. A person who lost his farm in a flood
   D. A healthy person who refuses to work

20. What does Qur'an 62:10 tell us after prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Spread through the land and seek Allah's bounty
   B. Beg
   C. Stop working
   D. Stay at home

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. State four features of the Islamic code of dressing. (4 marks)

22. State three rules for using working animals safely. (3 marks)

23. Describe how a class can show kindness to creatures in the school compound. (4 marks)

24. State four conditions of swalah. (4 marks)

25. State three evils of begging. (3 marks)

26. Give three positive uses of media. (3 marks)

27. List the first four pillars of swalah. (4 marks)

28. Explain tartib in swalah. (2 marks)

29. State three things that do not nullify wudhu. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #20 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — A light najasa
   Mukhaffafah means light.

2. C — Kindly, but avoid their saliva
   Islam teaches kindness to animals.

3. D — Remove it and wash with water until colour, smell and taste go
   Wash until the traces have gone.

4. A — Use water and wash hands with soap
   Water is best.

5. D — Heels, elbows and behind the ears
   Wash all parts carefully.

6. B — Washing certain body parts with water before prayer
   Wudhu is ablution.

7. B — The testimony of faith
   Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah...

8. D — East
   The sun rises in the east.

9. A — Fajr
   Fajr is at dawn.

10. D — Makkah
   The Kaaba is in Makkah.

11. B — Ruku
   Ruku is inside the prayer.

12. D — Bowing
   Ruku is bowing.

13. B — Ox
   Oxen pull ploughs and carts.

14. A — A goat
   Animals are living creatures of Allah.

15. A — Tracksuit with long trousers and sports headscarf
   It allows free movement and modesty.

16. B — The clothing of righteousness
   Good character is best.

17. B — Wastes time and harms eyes and sleep
   Excess is harmful.

18. D — Your passwords
   Passwords keep you safe.

19. C — A person who lost his farm in a flood
   Disaster victims deserve help.

20. A — Spread through the land and seek Allah's bounty
   Work and pray.

SECTION B
----
21. (4 marks)
   Answer: Cover the awrah, loose and not see-through, clean and neat, not for showing off, no rude words or pictures.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: Do not overload, give water and rest, do not beat, keep them healthy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule.

23. (4 marks)
   Answer: Plant and water trees, put out water for birds, keep the compound clean, do not harm insects and animals.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid action.

24. (4 marks)
   Answer: Islam and sanity; purity; covering the awrah; facing the Qibla; the time has come.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each condition.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: Loss of dignity, laziness, wasted resources, lies, harm to children.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: Learning, listening to Qur'an and lessons, keeping in touch with family, news, safe skills.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

27. (4 marks)
   Answer: Niyyah, qiyam, takbiratul ihram, and reciting Al-Fatiha.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: Doing the pillars in the correct order.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for order and 1 mark for an example.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: Eating, drinking, talking, laughing quietly, sweating.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
